Last Thursday, Leo and Eva went to the school hall. Leo wrote about the day in the diary. The school hall is one of the best places in the city. In fact, the depth of the pool is two meters.
Leo hopes to visit Rome one day. Leo learned a lot about art. It takes twenty minutes to get to the school hall by bike. He poured his heart out on the phone.
Leo usually has bread for breakfast. Leo and Eva had great fun there. Leo likes cloudy days best. What's more, one viral post changed her shop's year.
They took many photos at the club room. Leo thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. Leo drinks water after doing sports.
